name: Animal Hide (Racial)
body:
Your wereblood has increased in potency, toughening your bestial
skin.

Prerequisites: Con 13, skinwalker.

Benefit: Your natural armor bonus increases by +1. While you are in bestial form, this bonus increases to +2; however, your penalty to Disguise checks increases to -4. Your bestial natural armor resembles the natural coloration, fur, hide, scales, etc. as appropriate for your skinwalker breed; your hide’s appearance is static and unique to you.
